summary: Product Variants feature + deployment-blocker fixes tested end-to-end. All 6 backend items (B1-B6) and all 12 frontend items (F1-F12) PASS. Backend variant model auto-sums stock, normalises negative values to 0, generates UUIDs, preserves color_hex, and enforces admin-only writes. /health returns 200 on backend localhost. Non-destructive seed verified: product count stayed at 44 after supervisor restart. Frontend product editor renders VariantSection between PRODUCT DETAILS and VISIBILITY as specified; add/edit/save/publish flow works, base 'Stock quantity' auto-fills from variants (5+3+0=8, then 5+10+0=15 after edit) with hint text, out-of-stock badge shows for stock=0. Full Phase 2 regression (Inventory, Customers, Reviews, Promotions accessible via More tab) and Phase 1 regression (Dashboard KPIs, Orders list w/83 orders, Order detail, Products list) all render and are interactive.

minor.issue: Public ingress routes /health to the frontend (not /api-prefixed), so external K8s probes must hit /api/... path or directly the pod's 8001/health. Backend responds 200 on localhost:8001/health correctly.

ui_bugs.issue: Tapping 'Delete' in the products list more-menu re-shows the same sheet instead of triggering the DELETE API call. Test had to fall back to DELETE via API to clean up. Reproduced with product-more-<id> → Delete option on /admin/products.

action_items: Investigate admin products list delete flow: tapping Delete inside the ActionSheet does not call DELETE /api/products/{id}. Possibly the second confirmation step is missing or the confirm handler is not wired. Reproduce at /admin/products → more-menu → Delete.
Optional: expose /health under /api prefix (e.g. /api/health) so external K8s ingress can probe it. Currently only reachable on backend localhost:8001/health.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1824 lines — approaching the 700-line 'split' threshold. Consider splitting variants, products, orders, admin, seed into modules.
VariantIn model has no upper bound on stock/price_delta — acceptable but consider a sanity cap for safety.
Non-destructive seed logic is correctly gated on count==0 for both products and editorials. Good.

success_rate.frontend: 92% (11/12 flows pass; delete-from-list flow has a bug)

rca_of_issue: Delete-from-list bug RCA (partial): F11 attempted to delete a product via /admin/products → tap product-more-<id> → tap 'Delete' in bottom-sheet. The sheet contains Edit/Delete/Cancel; tapping Delete either does nothing observable or re-opens the same sheet. API GET after the flow still returned 200 for the product (i.e. not deleted). Product then had to be removed via direct DELETE /api/products/{id}. Recommended next step: read the destructive-confirm handler in /app/frontend/app/admin/products.tsx (or the ActionSheet component) and verify onDelete actually calls api('/products/{id}', { method: 'DELETE', auth: true }) and refreshes the list on success. Note that direct DELETE via API works correctly (returns 200), so this is a UI wiring issue, not a backend problem.
